# Eclipse texture credits

<!-- Auto-generated by tools/place-textures.py from tools/eclipse-textures.json. Do not edit manually. -->

Every texture set in this folder is published by its source under CC0 1.0 (public domain dedication).
Each set was resampled to 2048 x 2048 and repacked by `tools/place-textures.py`.
`<name>_c.webp` holds the colour map with ambient occlusion multiplied in at half strength, and for a paving its height in the alpha channel.
`<name>_n.jpg` holds the OpenGL normal X and Y in red and green and the roughness in blue.
A colour correction applied to a set is stated in its row.
